description: This file is a front-end HTML page for a database viewer application. It contains HTML structure, CSS styles, and embedded JavaScript code for dynamically loading and displaying database information, tables, and data fetched via API calls.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's tables in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data into HTML table format.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a table cell, handling special cases for objects and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
